_source: Captured from SM4 createApiServer (src/main/services/api-server.ts) via fastify inject, with no X-SocialMate-Envelope header — exactly what this MCP server receives. The v1.1 onSend hook wraps successes as { data } and errors as { error: { code, message, ...extra } }. Volatile fields (version, timestamp, retryAfterMs) are pinned. Recapture when the app changes an error shape.

error.message: This key is scoped to a different account
Every account this key is scoped to is suspended on Free. Upgrade to Pro to reactivate.

Batch sending is turned off. SocialMate is a personal messaging tool, not a broadcaster, so this is off by default. Ask the user to switch it on in the app under Settings → Advanced → Enable batch sending — every recipient must have consented. Do not work around this: send individually via POST /v1/accounts/{id}/messages, and never loop a send over a list.
Sending is paused during quiet hours
error.hint: Quiet hours are active. Upgrade to Pro to auto-queue this send and deliver it when quiet hours end.
